FindTutorsis one of the leading platforms for private tutoring and personalised education in the United Kingdom. We connect students with qualified tutors across languages and academic subjects, making learning flexible, accessible, and engaging.

We are currently looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Arabic Tutor to join our growing team. This is a flexible opportunity to work online from home or in person, helping students of all ages improve their Arabic language skills, including speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar, and conversation.

As an Arabic Tutor, you will deliver personalised 1-to-1 or small group lessons adapted to each student’s level (beginner, intermediate, advanced). You will support learners in building confidence, improving fluency, and achieving their academic, professional, or personal goals such as exams, travel, relocation, or religious and cultural understanding of the language.

You will also help students develop pronunciation, vocabulary, conversational Arabic, and structured learning strategies tailored to their needs and learning style.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong command of Arabic (native or C1/C2 level)

  • Ability to explain concepts clearly and adapt teaching methods

  • Passion for languages, teaching, and student development

  • No previous tutoring experience required (training or experience is a plus)

  • Ability to work with different ages and learning levels

  • Reliable internet connection for online teaching

ADVANTAGES

  • Fully flexible schedule

  • Work from home or anywhere in the world

  • Competitive pay: £20–£40 per hour

  • High demand for Arabic tutors (all levels)

  • Opportunity to gain experience in language teaching and coaching

  • Teach international students and grow your professional profile

Apply now and start your journey as an Arabic Tutor, helping students improve their Arabic skills with flexible opportunities at FindTutors.
